listing.name: Hacked Soil Nanites artifact mod
listing.summary: Basically I added a new soil nanites item that makes it so you can install it into any farming industry and it ignores the restrictions. As per user request this artifact is 5x rarer to find. The only thing I did different was make this item produce 3 extra units instead of 2. Enjoy.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a rare artifact item that installs into any farming industry to bypass restrictions and produce extra units.

description:
Hi!

I made a simple mod based on this idea here https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=26972.0

Basically I added a new soil nanites item that makes it so you can install it into any farming industry and it ignores the restrictions. As per user request this artifact is 5x rarer to find. The only thing I did different was make this item produce 3 extra units instead of 2. Enjoy. You can add this item to existing saves just fine. You can find this thing while exploring just like the regular soil nanites. Enjoy!

Download Here

Any problems etc lmk. My first mod for this game so im quite new to the whole thing.
